text:
incident-bot: ALERT: us-east1-primary GPU pool at 99% util, request queue >18k. Autoscaler tried to add nodes but received QuotaExceeded errors. Some routes falling back to queue-throttle. Pager -> @sre-oncall :rotating_light:

sre-oncall: seeing high 5xx spike and long tail latency on text-gen and chat endpoints. Customers reporting timeouts. Starting triage.

alice: I'm checking autoscaler controller logs and pool quotas now. Any immediate mitigation suggestions?

ben: if autoscale can't add nodes due to quota we should: 1) throttle non-prod/low-priority routes 2) enable regional spillover to eu-west for compatible models 3) serve smaller-quantized variants for burst traffic.

carmen: quick note — some routes are pinned to model v2-large only available in us-east1. When spillover attempted we got variant-mismatch errors for ~30% of requests.

alice: confirming autoscaler logs show: 
```
2026-09-09T15:34:12Z ERROR autoscaler: failed to request nodes: QuotaExceeded: GPU quota 64 -> 0 available
2026-09-09T15:34:12Z WARN  router: attempted spillover to eu-west but 29% routes returned ModelVariantIncompatible
```

devops-bot: Runbook ref: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-scale (section 4: spillover + throttles). Enacting immediate steps per runbook.

dave: I'm going to flip low-priority route weights to 0.1 and enable request-level throttling for free-tier. Command: `rbctl route set-weight --route free-tier --weight 0.1 --region us-east1`

emily: I'll publish an emergency policy to allow eu-west to accept v2-large as a temporary alias to v2-medium (quality tradeoff) for specific customer tenants. Will coordinate with model-team.

ben: prefer toggle that only affects non-SLA customers first. We don't want to degrade paying customers.

alice: Oncall note: started an emergency quota request with cloud provider (ticket #CP-54821), but ETA is unknown. Meanwhile applying two mitigations: 1) throttle & defer low-priority; 2) selective spillover for compatible routes.

carmen: Pushing a small router policy change: map fallback-model v2-medium -> v2-large-compatible for eu-west for routes tagged "spillable". Patch below: 
```json
{"route_filter": "tag:spillable", "fallback": "v2-medium:eu-west"}
```

incident-bot: NOTE: Customer-impact classification updated -> P2 (widespread degraded latency + some timeouts). Visible to ~12% of production requests.

emily: I'm coordinating with account teams for top-10 tenants showing errors. Drafting status update.

alice: After throttle & policy change queue dropped from 18k -> 6.2k in 4 minutes. Latency on priority routes improving. Still seeing sporadic 503s for pinned routes.

ben: For pinned routes we should enable automatic fallback to smaller model variant in-region (if policy allows). If customers have strict model pins, we'll need support approval.

carmen: Started canary for automatic small-variant fallback for 5% of traffic to pinned routes (non-enterprise tenants only). Monitor perf & hallucination rates.

devops-bot: Applied temporary circuit-breaker on non-critical endpoints: `rbctl policy set circuit_breaker --scope noncritical --max-inflight 1500`

alice: Autoscaler metrics: attempted scale 32 -> 64 nodes but cloud returned QuotaExceeded. Current pool: 64 nodes (limit reached). Confirmed other teams not hoarding GPUs.

dave: Also found one runaway job in dev-sandbox consuming 8 gpus, killed it. That reclaimed 8 GPUs but still below request.

emily: Customer comms: posted short update to status page and flagged top-10 enterprise customers via AMs.

sre-oncall: handing off to night oncall @dave in 25 minutes. Current actions that must persist: throttles, spillover policy, canary fallback, and monitoring alert thresholds tightened.

dave: ack. I'll keep throttles in place and watch error-rate dashboard. If queue >10k again, escalate to oncall lead.

incident-bot: ACTIONS_SUMMARY: throttle low-priority routes; enable selective eu-west spillover for compatible models; canary fallback for pinned routes; applied circuit-breaker; killed runaway dev job; cloud quota ticket CP-54821 opened.

ben: follow-ups: 1) request long-term quota increase, 2) audit route pinning that prevents spillover, 3) add preflight check to never allow >25% of production pinned to single region.

emily: will draft post-incident blameless RCA and customer impact timeline. Target: initial postmortem in 48h.

alice: we'll also add an autoscaler retry path that prefers nodal rebalancing across regions before immediate quota request. Filing engineering task ENG-9482.

incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated -> degradation decreasing, P2 still open for monitoring.

sre-oncall: thanks everyone. handing off to @dave for overnight monitoring. If error-rate crosses threshold, page escalation policy.

dave: on it. leaving a short log note and handoff checklist in #incidents-runbooks.

emily: adding postmortem owners: emily (customer impact), alice (autoscaler), ben (routing), carmen (models).

carmen: saved current router config snapshot -> `router-config-1987654322.snapshot` and uploaded to /internal/incidents/1987654322/

incident-bot: THREAD CLOSED (monitoring) - updates to be posted here.
